title: Endpoint Telemetry: file_write v1
description: Raw telemetry event emitted on a file system write operation detected by an EDR agent. Covers create, modify, delete, and rename operations.

file_path.description: Full path of the file that was written, created, deleted, or renamed. Normalizer maps to 'domain' field fallback.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of file contents after the write. Omit for delete operations.

file_size.description: File size in bytes after the write operation.

destination_path.description: Target path for rename operations. Null for non-rename operations.

process_name.description: Name of the process that performed the file operation.

pid.description: PID of the process that performed the file operation.

entropy.description: Shannon entropy of file contents after write. High entropy (> 7.0) may indicate encryption or packing.
